component: Tabmail selected-state CSS and child attribute mapping

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The tab port replaces selected/visuallyselected="true" comparisons with presence selectors in its tab-specific styles. Comm maps .tab-line selected from the tab’s visuallyselected attribute, so the appearance test now queries .tab-line[selected]. Other control attributes keep their own contracts. The upstream tab producer and inheritance engine are unpaired; this is a local consumer/mapping observation, not a global boolean-attribute or rendered behavior guarantee.
title: Tab selection presence selectors follow the comm widget attribute mapping
